name: list_history
description: List the git commit history for a wiki document. Returns commits newest-first as `[{sha, author, ts, message}, ...]`. Useful for finding a historical sha to pass to `read_doc`, or for understanding what's changed recently before proposing an edit. The list follows renames (`git log --follow`).

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file. Must end in `.md`.
